slug: 2025-12-18 Cabo Verde advances digitalisation of National Health System (SNS)

facts.fact: The Minister of Health announced that Cabo Verde is advancing a unique patient code, digital medical records and electronic prescriptions centralising clinical data so professionals can access a patient's history across hospitals and health centres.

The Ministry of Health's terms of reference (published 2026-04-28, with the Special Projects Management Unit, UGPE) seek a consultancy to design, install and train users on an interoperable laboratory information system for 20 public laboratories, required to integrate with DHIS2, existing LIMS, the health information system SIS and national surveillance systems, and to conform to HL7/FHIR.
